info.title: Adaptive Learning API
info.description: Operational endpoints plus the Phase 1 learning MVP for AWS SOA-C03.

get.description:
Returns `200` when the database is reachable and `503` when it is not, so a
load balancer can stop routing to an instance whose dependency is down.

503.description: Service is running but the database is unavailable

get.description:
The document is the source of truth for the TypeScript client. Regenerate it
with `cargo run -p adaptive-learn-api --bin export-openapi` or the web
`pnpm generate:api` script.

get.summary: Lists certifications, versions, domains, and authored tasks.
Returns the pre-quiz learning content for a certification domain.
get.description:
This is the Knowledge Map curriculum: modules, knowledge nodes, and
progressive reveals. It is a discovery mechanic, not a scored assessment, so
it is deliberately separate from mission issuance and scoring.

404.description: No learning content for this domain

post.summary: Issues a deterministic mission for a task.
Scores one attempt and returns immediate feedback.

409.description: Mission completed or content version mismatch

post.summary: Reconciles a batch of attempts, re-scoring each against canonical content.

get.summary: Returns a device's settled Bits balance.

AnswerPayload.description: Answer primitives for one attempt. Exactly one field is set.

assignments.description: Slot id to piece id assignments for configuration builder.

choice_path.description: Ordered choice ids for troubleshooting or a scenario chain.

edges.description: Directed `[from, to]` pairs for node connection.

evidence_ids.description: Selected evidence source ids for evidence selection.

faulty_ids.description: Selected faulty element ids for spot the fault.

ordered_ids.description: Item ids in submitted order for ordering.

placements.description: Item id to category id placements for classification.

positions.description: Item id to position for two-dimensional placement.

oneOf.description: Selected components and relationships for reconstruction.

slot_values.description: Slot id to option id values for fill slots.

token_values.description: Slot id to token id values for command assembly.

typed_answers.description: Slot id to raw typed text for typed fill-in-the-blank.

content_version.description: Content version the client believes it is answering.

event_id.description: Stable event identifier for this attempt.

occurred_at.description: When the attempt occurred on the device.

AssessmentMode.description:
How an attempt measures knowledge.

The first four are the base evidence modes from `docs/06-learning-engine.md`.
The remaining two are explicit Phase 1 subtypes used by tactile
interactions; they are still treated as evidence modes, not proven
independent latent abilities.

oneOf.description: Correct item-to-category placements.
Correct order of item ids.
Correct directed relationships.
Correct piece placed in each slot.

edges.description: Optional directed `[from, to]` piece-id pairs for `graph` layouts.

oneOf.description: Evidence source ids that are relevant to the question.

relevant_ids.description: Relevant evidence ids. Every other candidate is a false positive.

oneOf.description: Element ids that are faulty.
Correct value id for each slot id.
Correct decisions for a diagnosis/remediation scenario.

correct_choice_ids.description: Step id to the choice ids that are correct at that step.

expected_path.description: The intended ordered choice ids from the start step.

oneOf.description: Correct decisions for an authored decision chain.

correct_choice_ids.description: Step id to the choice ids that are correct at that step.

expected_path.description: The intended ordered choice ids from the start step.

oneOf.description: Correct component assignment for each role.
Correct tolerant region for each placed item.

regions.description: Item id to its canonical region.

oneOf.description: Correct token for each ordered slot.
Accepted typed answers for each inline blank.

answers.description: Slot id to the authored accepted answers.

CanonicalAnswer.description: The canonical answer for a question.

CertificationDto.description: A certification with its versioned blueprints.

concepts.description:
Learner-facing knowledge concepts referenced by this version.

Mission payloads carry only concept ids; the catalog supplies the names so
summaries never have to render a raw identifier.

name.description: Short learner-facing name, for example `CloudFormation change sets`.

ConceptWeight.description: A concept mapped to a question, with its share of the evidence.

weight.description: Share of the question attributed to this concept, in `(0, 1]`.

ConfigSlot.description: A named role the learner assigns a component to.

label.description: Learner-facing label for the role, for example `IPv4 default route target`.

learning_available.description: Whether pre-quiz learning content exists for this domain.

ErrorResponse.description: Envelope returned for every API error.

bits_preview.description:
Bits the learner is expected to earn when this attempt is settled.

A preview only: the authoritative balance is settled during sync.

correct.description: Whether the attempt was fully correct.

FillSlot.description: A blank the learner must fill from a constrained option set.

label.description: Learner-facing label for the blank, for example `Destination`.

FixedNode.description: A node that is already provided as part of the scaffold.

position.description: Where the node is shown relative to the slots in `linear` layouts.

x.description: Authored horizontal position for `graph` layouts, in `0..=1`.

y.description: Authored vertical position for `graph` layouts, in `0..=1`.

FixedNodePosition.description: Where a provided node sits relative to a reconstruction's slots.

HealthResponse.description:
Safe operational health payload. Never includes connection strings, hosts,
versions of dependencies, or other internals.

oneOf.description: Place items into categories.
Arrange items into a meaningful order.
Connect nodes with directed relationships.
Rebuild a structure by placing pieces into a scaffold's slots.

fixed_nodes.description: Nodes already provided as context. Not part of the answer.

oneOf.description: Select the evidence sources relevant to a question.

evidence.description: Candidate telemetry, log, or evidence sources.

oneOf.description: Identify the faulty element(s) in an authored configuration.

elements.description: Structured elements (components, rules, rows) the learner inspects.

oneOf.description: Fill blanks with values drawn from a constrained option set.

options.description: Values the learner may use. May contain distractors.

slots.description: Blanks to fill, in presentation order.

oneOf.description: Follow a deterministic diagnosis/remediation decision tree.
Follow a deterministic authored decision chain.
Assemble a configuration by assigning components to named roles.

pieces.description: Components the learner may assign. May contain distractors.

slots.description: Named roles that each expect one component.

oneOf.description: Place items on a two-axis conceptual map.
Assemble an ordered statement from a token pool.

tokens.description: Tokens the learner may use. May contain distractors.

oneOf.description: Fill inline blanks inside a sentence by typing the missing text.

slots.description: Blanks referenced anywhere in the content, in declaration order.

Interaction.description: Interaction definition shown to the learner. Contains no answer key.

InteractionType.description: The tactile interaction family a question uses.

IssueMissionRequest.description: Request to issue a mission for a quiz mode.

domain_id.description: Domain to scope a domain quiz to. Ignored for other modes.

mode.description: Quiz mode deciding how the server selects questions.

task_id.description: Task to scope a task practice to. Required for `task_practice`.

KnowledgeNode.description: One knowledge card on the map.

concept_ids.description: Certification concepts this node teaches. The bridge to quiz evidence.

map_position.description: Authored position on the map in `0..=1` space.

prerequisite_node_ids.description: Nodes that must be unlocked before this node becomes ready.

prompts.description: Progressive reveal prompts. All required prompts unlock the node.

KnowledgePrompt.description: One progressive-reveal prompt on a knowledge card.

id.description: Stable prompt identifier within the node.

kind.description: Prompt kind, which selects the shared icon and styling vocabulary.

label.description: Learner-facing label, authored by the curriculum.

placeholder.description: Blank text shown before the reveal.

required.description: Whether revealing this prompt counts toward unlocking the node.

reveal.description: The information revealed when the learner taps the blank.

LearningDesign.description: The vocabulary and rules shown to learners on the map.

mastery_note.description: Reminder that discovery is not mastery.

progress_label.description: Label for discovery progress, for example `Discovery Progress`.

LearningDomainMeta.description: Domain identity within a certification blueprint.

LearningDomainResponse.description:
Learner-facing learning content for one certification domain.

This is the discovery layer that sits before retrieval practice. Reveals are
present because progressive disclosure is the mechanic, not a secret. Quiz
canonical answers are never included.

LearningModule.description: A group of knowledge nodes unlocked along one path.

prerequisite_module_ids.description: Modules that must be completed before this one becomes available.

skill_ids.description: Exam skill ids this module teaches.

task_ids.description: Exam task ids this module teaches.

oneOf.description: A short prose reveal.

text.description: Revealed text. Keep it to one or two sentences.

oneOf.description: An ordered sequence, rendered top-to-bottom with arrows.
A compact set of bullets.
Keyword clues, rendered as compact chips.
A side-by-side or stacked comparison.

LearningReveal.description:
How a revealed prompt renders. Deliberately not a plain string: the
curriculum distinguishes prose, sequences, comparisons, and keyword clues.

MapPosition.description: Normalized position on the knowledge map.

MissionResponse.description: A server-issued mission with its questions.

Node.description: A node in a connection graph.

x.description: Horizontal position in an abstract `0..=1` layout space.

y.description: Vertical position in an abstract `0..=1` layout space.

PlacementAxis.description: One axis of a two-dimensional conceptual map.

high_label.description: Label for the high end of the axis.

low_label.description: Label for the low end of the axis.

PlacementPoint.description: A point submitted for a two-dimensional placement.

PlacementRegion.description: A tolerant canonical region on a two-dimensional map.

PromptKind.description:
The shared prompt vocabulary. Icons are selected by the UI from this kind,
so content can change labels without the renderer special-casing nodes.

QuestionView.description: A question shown to the learner. Contains no answer key.

QuizMode.description:
The quiz mode a mission was issued for.

`task_practice` is kept for the demo/task flow and internal debugging; the
three learner-facing modes are quick, domain, and full practice.

edges.description: Directed `[from, to]` relationships the learner drew.

placements.description: Slot id to piece id placements.

ReconstructionLayout.description: How a reconstruction scaffold represents structure.

ReconstructionSlot.description: A structural position the learner fills with a piece.

x.description: Authored horizontal position for `graph` layouts, in `0..=1`.

y.description: Authored vertical position for `graph` layouts, in `0..=1`.

RevealColumn.description: One titled column of a comparison reveal.

ScenarioStep.description: One authored decision point in a branching scenario.

next_step_by_choice.description: Choice id to next step id. A choice with no entry ends the scenario.

stage.description: What kind of decision this step represents.

SourceRef.description: A reference to the official source of a content unit.

SyncEventRequest.description: One attempt in a sync batch.

content_version.description: Content version the answer was produced against.

accepted.description: Whether the event is now accepted server-side.

bits_settled.description: Bits settled for this event (0 when rejected or already settled).

SyncRequest.description: Request to sync a batch of evaluated attempts.

bits_balance.description: Authoritative settled Bits balance after this batch.

TaskDto.description: A task with a count of authored questions.

TypedBlankAnswer.description:
Accepted typed answers for one blank.

Matching is deterministic: the normalized typed answer must equal one of the
explicitly authored aliases. There is no semantic or fuzzy matching.

accepted_answers.description: Authored answers that are accepted for this blank.

TypedBlankSlot.description:
A blank the learner fills by typing free text.

The slot's `id` is referenced as `{{id}}` inside a content template.

id.description: Stable identifier within the question, used as the `{{id}}` placeholder.

label.description: Learner-facing label for the blank, for example `Policy result`.

placeholder.description: Optional hint text shown inside the empty input.

oneOf.description: A sentence or short prose statement containing `{{slot_id}}` placeholders.
A syntax-highlighted source-code sample containing `{{slot_id}}` placeholders.

template.description:
Code template containing `{{slot_id}}` placeholders. Newlines and
indentation are significant.

oneOf.description: A table whose cells may contain text or code templates.

TypedFillContent.description:
Presentation context for a typed fill-in-the-blank interaction.

Presentation is explicit and tagged, so the renderer never has to guess
whether authored content is prose, source code, or a table. Blank positions
are always marked with `{{slot_id}}` inside a `template`.

oneOf.description: A text template containing `{{slot_id}}` placeholders.
A syntax-highlighted code template containing `{{slot_id}}` placeholders.

TypedFillTableCell.description: Presentation of one typed fill-in-the-blank table cell.

TypedFillTableColumn.description: A column in a typed fill-in-the-blank table.

TypedFillTableRow.description: A row in a typed fill-in-the-blank table.

cells.description: Column id to the cell presented in that column.

tags.name: learning
tags.description: Pre-quiz knowledge maps and discovery progress
